description: When to call: you have a question or a payload and want the cheapest verified step. MATCH lists program classes and pages (free without input). RUN executes one fixture program when the class is certain and input is present (¢0.1). Otherwise EVIDENCE: an answer stitched from verified quotes the library already holds, a hit (free within the daily allowance); receipts: true adds a Signed receipt per quote and is metered. Set allow_escalate only to send YOUR ask to YOUR engine. A miss names research/deposit with prices.

class_id.description: Force a program class when you already know it

input.description: Payload to run through a matched program

receipts.description: A Signed receipt per quote on EVIDENCE (default false; with receipts the step is metered)

title: MATCH, RUN, or EVIDENCE (run 0.0010); evidence is a hit without receipts
